name: arma3
title: Arma 3

competitive_decision.why: Harness only: the generated single-player VR mission, never a server. The entry exists for phase 1's target oracle and is refused to the app by test_only.

decided.why: Phase 1's ground truth: the mission publishes a target's head through worldToScreen. BattlEye's service, when running, refuses the policy before the allowlist is consulted; the harness runs the no-BattlEye control.

notes: Not a shipped entry and never will be while the title has servers.
